headline: Malawi reaches first Women’s World Cup after beating Ghana
summary: A 2–1 win sends Malawi into the 2027 Women’s World Cup for the first time.
script: Malawi has reached its first Women’s World Cup. A two-one win over Ghana secured the historic qualification, sending the country into the 2027 tournament after a breakthrough night for the She Flames.
